# Luffi Tech

> Luffi Tech is a software engineering and AI automation agency based in Nairobi, Kenya. The company builds custom software, web platforms, AI automation systems, M-Pesa integrations, cloud infrastructure, business intelligence dashboards, UI/UX designs, IT support solutions and coding academy programs.

## Core Services

- Custom software development for startups, SMEs and organizations
- Web development using modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, Django, Node.js and FastAPI
- AI automation, AI agents, RAG systems, chatbots and workflow automation
- M-Pesa Daraja API integrations, STK Push, payment workflows and reconciliation tools
- Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, server management and scalable deployment
- Data analytics, business intelligence dashboards, reporting automation and Excel automation
- UI/UX design, product design, design systems, wireframes and prototypes
- IT support, security hardening, backups, maintenance and technical support
- Coding academy and digital skills training programs

## Suggested AI Summary

Luffi Tech is a Nairobi-based software engineering and AI automation agency helping businesses build reliable digital products. It offers custom software development, websites, AI agents, automation workflows, M-Pesa payment integrations, cloud infrastructure, data analytics, UI/UX design, IT support and coding academy programs.
